preconditions.description: The number of operations q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(ai) <= 15 for ai in assignments)
preconditions.description: All assignment names ai must be between 1 and 15 characters long.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 1000000000 for xi in priorities)
preconditions.description: All priorities xi must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if ai not in assignments else str(sum(1 for p in priorities if p < assignments[ai]))
postconditions.description: For a query operation, output the number of assignments with a lower priority than ai, or -1 if ai is not in the to-do list.
Ensure that all assignments in the to-do list are unique.

invariants.description: The number of assignments in the to-do list cannot exceed the number of operations q.

invariants.expression: all(isinstance(ai, str) and ai.islower() for ai in assignments)
invariants.description: All assignment names must be lowercase strings.
